messages:
anna-sec: FYI — Brightshore tenant onboarding call at 2pm PT. They want a concise bundle showing privilege separation (privsep) between control plane and tenant keys, plus RBAC deltas and audit snapshots. Any short checklist we can hand them before the call?

niya-custsec: Thanks Anna. customer specifically asked for: key rotation policy, evidence of KMS usage separation (envelope vs data keys), role binding changes since last month, and a short proof that no service account had admin during onboarding.

sam-eng: For the RBAC delta we usually export role-bindings and do a diff. Minimal deliverables that satisfy most customers: 1) RBAC delta CSV, 2) signed audit-log snapshot (last 24h), 3) KMS key metadata + rotation policy, 4) step-by-step repro of the signed proof.

lucas-ops: Agreed. Proposed quick commands:

```bash
# export role bindings for tenant 'brightshore'
kubectl get rolebinding --namespace brightshore -o json > /tmp/brightshore-rolebinding.json
# export IAM audit slice
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/audit --start-time $START --end-time $END > /tmp/brightshore-audit.json
# create archive and sign
tar czf brightshore-evidence.tar.gz /tmp/brightshore-*.json
openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /opt/keys/infra_signing.key -out brightshore-evidence.sig brightshore-evidence.tar.gz
```

lucas-ops: We call the signature + checksum the "hashchain snapshot" in our playbooks — clarity helps with auditors.

mike-sre: Quick note: make sure we redact user emails in the public bundle. Customer can get the unredacted package through an encrypted transfer after NDA is signed.

niya-custsec: Brightshore will only accept evidence delivered via their SFTP with PGP envelope. Can we produce PGP encrypted tarball instead of plain tar?

sam-eng: Yes — we should add a step to encrypt the signed bundle:

```bash
gpg --output brightshore-evidence.tar.gz.gpg --encrypt --recipient brightshore@keys.example.com brightshore-evidence.tar.gz
```

anna-sec: Also they asked for a short explanation of privsep controls — one paragraph and a reference to logs that prove no cross-tenant key access occurred. Draft: "Control plane services are separated from tenant key material via envelope encryption. Tenant workloads only interact with tenant-specific data keys; only the control plane can call the KMS management API. Audit logs show KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt calls scoped to tenant-key ARNs" — happy to refine.

niya-custsec: Good start. Customer also wants a timeline for key rotation and proof the most recent rotation occurred. Can we include KMS key-rotation event IDs and correlated audit entries?

lucas-ops: Yes — we'll include KMS metadata JSON (key id, creation date, rotation schedule) and the rotation_event_id with a link to the audit entry. Example snippet: "rotation_event_id": "evt-20260319083455".

sec-bot: automated-notice: evidence-bundle/3608001112 prepared (unsigned) at s3://redwood-sec-evidence/dryrun/brightshore/3608001112/ — internal only :lock:

mike-sre: Action items: 1) Sam — generate RBAC delta CSV + redacted audit slice (owner: @sam-eng) 2) Lucas — assemble archive, sign with infra key, encrypt with customer's PGP (owner: @lucas-ops) 3) Anna — draft the privsep paragraph and KMS rotation blurb (owner: @anna-sec) 4) Niya — coordinate SFTP endpoint and NDA status (owner: @niya-custsec). Please update thread when done. :white_check_mark:

anna-sec: I'll draft the paragraph and upload to the shared drive in 30m. If anyone hits blockers on the signing key or PGP, ping me directly.

sam-eng: Starting RBAC export now. Will post the CSV and short diff here when ready.

lucas-ops: I'll run the tar/sign/encrypt flow and validate checksums. Will attach instructions so customer can verify the signature on their side.

niya-custsec: Thanks all. I'll confirm the SFTP + PGP key and share instructions with Brightshore before the 2pm call.

anna-sec: Perfect — feel free to reference our "hashchain snapshot" method and link to the internal playbook (internal-only).

sec-bot: reminder: create ticket SEC-ONB-482 and attach the final bundle for retention (30 days staging)

mike-sre: Thanks team — this looks tight. We'll treat any additional asks as follow-up items from the call.
